# Metric families served on etcd 3.7.2's metrics listener (--metrics=basic),
# the union of all three Anton members on 2026-10-23. Labelled counters such
# as etcd_network_peer_sent_failures_total appear only after their first event.
# Refresh after an etcd minor upgrade from each member's /metrics "# TYPE" lines.
